question: ESS is a Computer based system that allows users to transform enterprise data. ESS stands for: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Executive Service System
Executive Senior System
Executive Support System
Executive Series system
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Executive Support System

Explanation:
ESS stands for Executive Support System. It is a computer-based system that allows users to transform enterprise data and aids top management in decision-making. ESS is designed specifically for executive-level officers and includes features such as strategic planning, data mining, and reporting. The system helps executives analyze large volumes of data, generate insights, and make informed decisions. ESS is a type of Decision Support System (DSS) that focuses on the needs of senior management. It provides easy access to internal and external information relevant to organizational goals.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What does ESS stand for? → Executive Support System
☛ Who uses ESS? → Top management and executive officers
☛ What is the main purpose of ESS? → To assist in decision-making and analyze enterprise data
☛ What type of system is ESS? → Computer-based information system
☛ What features are included in ESS? → Strategic planning, data mining, and reporting
question_hi: ESS एक कंप्यूटर आधारित प्रणाली है जो उपयोगकर्ताओं को एंटरप्राइज़ डेटा को बदलने की अनुमति देती है। ESS का मतलब है: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 2)

कार्यकारी वरिष्ठ प्रणाली

कार्यकारी श्रृंखला प्रणाली
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है कार्यकारी सहायता प्रणाली

Explanation:
ESS का पूरा नाम Executive Support System है, जिसे हिंदी में कार्यकारी सहायता प्रणाली कहा जाता है। यह एक कंप्यूटर-आधारित प्रणाली है जो शीर्ष प्रबंधन को निर्णय लेने में सहायता प्रदान करती है। ESS उपयोगकर्ताओं को एंटरप्राइज़ डेटा को बदलने और विश्लेषण करने की अनुमति देती है। यह प्रणाली मुख्य रूप से कार्यकारी अधिकारियों के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई है और इसमें रणनीतिक योजना, डेटा माइनिंग और रिपोर्टिंग जैसी सुविधाएं शामिल होती हैं। ESS का उपयोग संगठन के भीतर महत्वपूर्ण निर्णय लेने में किया जाता है।

☛ ESS का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है? → निर्णय लेने में सहायता और एंटरप्राइज़ डेटा का विश्लेषण

question: ______ is a high level programming language for scientific and mathematical use. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: RFID
EDP
FORTRAN
COBOL
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is FORTRAN

Explanation:
FORTRAN stands for Formula Translation. It was developed by IBM in 1957 and is a high-level programming language designed primarily for scientific and mathematical computations. FORTRAN revolutionized numerical analysis, computer simulation, and complex mathematical modeling. It is still widely used in the scientific community. Among the other options, RFID is a technology, EDP is a process, and COBOL is used for business applications.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of FORTRAN → Formula Translation
☛ Developer of FORTRAN → IBM
☛ Year of development of FORTRAN → 1957
☛ Primary use of FORTRAN → Scientific and mathematical computation
☛ Language for business applications → COBOL
question_hi: ______ वैज्ञानिक और गणितीय उपयोग के लिए एक उच्च स्तरीय प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 1)

ईडीपी

Solution: सही उत्तर है फोरट्रान

Explanation:

question: Which of the following refers to protection of data against accidental or intentional disclosure to unauthorised persons or unauthorised modification or destruction? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Database
Data Security
Privacy data
Data redundancy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Data Security

Explanation:
Data security refers to the protection of data from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or destruction. It ensures that only authorized individuals can access data and maintains the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. A database is merely a collection of data, privacy data is a type of data, and data redundancy refers to duplication of data.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Three main pillars of data security → Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability
☛ Technologies related to data security → Encryption, Firewall, Access Control
☛ Meaning of data integrity → Protection from unauthorized modification
☛ Way to ensure confidentiality → Grant access only to authorized users
☛ Threats to data security → Hacking, Malware, Phishing
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अनधिकृत व्यक्तियों को आकस्मिक या जानबूझकर प्रकटीकरण या अनधिकृत संशोधन या विनाश के खिलाफ डेटा की सुरक्षा को संदर्भित करता है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: डेटाबेस
डेटा सुरक्षा
गोपनीयता डेटा
डेटा अतिरेक
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है डेटा सुरक्षा

Explanation:
डेटा सुरक्षा का अर्थ है डेटा को अनधिकृत पहुंच, प्रकटीकरण, संशोधन या विनाश से बचाना। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि केवल अधिकृत व्यक्ति ही डेटा तक पहुंच सकें और डेटा की गोपनीयता, अखंडता और उपलब्धता बनी रहे। डेटाबेस केवल डेटा का संग्रह है, गोपनीयता डेटा एक प्रकार का डेटा है, और डेटा अतिरेक डेटा के दोहराव को दर्शाता है।

☛ डेटा सुरक्षा के खतरे → हैकिंग, मैलवेयर, फिशिंग

question: A computer monitor is also known by the name: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: CPU
LED
CCTV
VDU
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is VDU

Explanation:
A computer monitor is also known as a VDU, which stands for Visual Display Unit. It is an output device that displays processed data from the computer in visual form. CPU is a processing unit, LED is a display technology, and CCTV is a security camera system. The term VDU is primarily used for monitors, especially in the context of older CRT monitors. In modern times, LCD, LED, and OLED monitors are common, but the term VDU is still in use. The monitor is an essential part of a computer that allows users to view the graphical interface, text, and images.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of VDU → Visual Display Unit
☛ Monitor is which type of device → Output device
☛ Full form of CPU → Central Processing Unit
☛ Full form of LED → Light Emitting Diode
☛ Full form of CCTV → Closed Circuit Television
question_hi: कंप्यूटर मॉनीटर को इस नाम से भी जाना जाता है: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: सीपीयू
एलईडी
सीसीटीवी
वीडीयू
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है वीडीयू

Explanation:
कंप्यूटर मॉनीटर को वीडीयू (VDU) भी कहा जाता है, जिसका पूरा नाम विजुअल डिस्प्ले यूनिट है। यह एक आउटपुट डिवाइस है जो कंप्यूटर से प्रोसेस्ड डेटा को विजुअल रूप में प्रदर्शित करता है। CPU एक प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट है, LED एक प्रकार की डिस्प्ले तकनीक है, और CCTV एक सुरक्षा कैमरा सिस्टम है। VDU शब्द का प्रयोग मुख्यतः मॉनीटर के लिए किया जाता है, विशेषकर पुराने CRT मॉनीटर के संदर्भ में। आधुनिक समय में LCD, LED और OLED मॉनीटर आम हैं, लेकिन VDU शब्द अभी भी प्रचलित है। मॉनीटर कंप्यूटर का एक अनिवार्य भाग है जो उपयोगकर्ता को ग्राफिकल इंटरफेस, टेक्स्ट और इमेज देखने की अनुमति देता है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ VDU का पूरा नाम → विजुअल डिस्प्ले यूनिट
☛ मॉनीटर किस प्रकार का डिवाइस है → आउटपुट डिवाइस
☛ CPU का पूरा नाम → सेंट्रल प्रोसेसिंग यूनिट
☛ LED का पूरा नाम → लाइट एमिटिंग डायोड
☛ CCTV का पूरा नाम → क्लोज्ड सर्किट टेलीविजन

question: Which among the following is the largest unit of memory of a computer system? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Exabyte
Zetabyte
Petabyte
Yottabyte
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Yottabyte

Explanation:
Computer memory units start from byte and increase in size. Among them, Yottabyte (YB) is the largest unit. It equals 1,024 zettabytes or 10^24 bytes. Zettabyte (ZB) is smaller, exabyte (EB) is even smaller, and petabyte (PB) is the smallest among the given options. Yottabyte is used to measure global data storage.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Largest unit of data measurement → Yottabyte
☛ Number of bytes in 1 yottabyte → 10^24 bytes
☛ Unit after yottabyte → Brontobyte (unofficial)
☛ Smallest data unit → Bit
☛ Number of terabytes in 1 petabyte → 1,024 terabytes

question: How many columns are there in a sheet of Excel 2010? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1024
16384
16024
1600
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 16384

Explanation:
A sheet in Excel 2010 contains a total of 16384 columns. These columns are labeled from A to XFD. In Excel 2003, there were only 256 columns (up to IV), but Excel 2010 increased this to 16384. This was a significant improvement that enhanced data handling capacity. Additionally, a sheet has 1048576 rows. This information is commonly asked in computer awareness sections. The number of columns in Excel 2010 is 2^14 = 16384.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the total number of columns in Excel 2010? → 16384
☛ How many rows are there in an Excel 2010 sheet? → 1048576
☛ What is the last column name in Excel 2010? → XFD
☛ How many columns were there in Excel 2003? → 256
☛ 2 raised to which power gives the number of columns in Excel 2010? → 2^14

options_hi: 1024

Explanation:

question: Who among the following is considered as the father of the world wide web? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: ​Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee
Robert Cailliau
Pei-Yuan Wei
James H. Clark
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee

Explanation:
Sir Timothy John Berners-Lee is considered the father of the World Wide Web. He invented HTTP, HTML, and URL in 1989, which are the foundations of the web. He also created the first web browser and server in 1990 while working at CERN. Robert Cailliau was a co-inventor, Pei-Yuan Wei developed the ViolaWWW browser, and James H. Clark co-founded Netscape.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What was the name of Berners-Lee's first web browser? → WorldWideWeb
☛ Which organization develops web standards? → W3C
☛ What does HTTP stand for? → HyperText Transfer Protocol
☛ What does HTML stand for? → HyperText Markup Language

Explanation:

question: An interface between the human user and the computer hardware is known as: ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: operating system
software
modem
operating unit
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is operating system

Explanation:
An operating system is system software that acts as an interface between the human user and computer hardware. It manages hardware resources and provides services for application software. question: FORTRAN is the ______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/02/2021) Shift 1)

Explanation:
FORTRAN stands for Formula Translation. It was developed by IBM in 1957. It was the first high-level programming language, which reduced the complexity of machine language. It is based on procedural and imperative programming paradigms. After FORTRAN, languages like COBOL (business), BASIC (general purpose), and C (system programming) were developed. question: Which of the following acts as an interface between the CPU and the main memory? (RRB ALP CBT 2 (Electrician)(22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: Magnetic tape
Hard Disk
Cache memory
Compact Disk
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cache memory

Explanation:
Cache memory is a small, fast memory located between the CPU and the main memory (RAM). It stores frequently accessed data and instructions, reducing access time and improving processing speed. It acts as a buffer to bridge the speed gap between the CPU and main memory. Magnetic tape, hard disk, and compact disk are secondary storage devices and do not directly interface with the CPU. Cache memory is organized into levels L1, L2, and L3, with L1 being the fastest and smallest. It uses SRAM technology, which is faster but more expensive than DRAM used in main memory.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Fastest memory between CPU and RAM → Cache memory
☛ Cache level built inside the CPU chip → L1 cache
☛ Primary purpose of cache memory → Increase data access speed
☛ Not an example of secondary storage → Cache memory
☛ Technology used by cache memory → SRAM (Static RAM)

question: ______ is an improvement on WEP used in Wi-Fi networks. (RRB ALP CBT 2 (Electrician)(22/01/2019) Shift 3)
options: SSL
WPA
SAAS
POP
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is WPA

Explanation:
WPA (Wi-Fi Protected Access) is an improved version of WEP (Wired Equivalent Privacy) for wireless network security. WEP had security vulnerabilities due to weak encryption, which were addressed in WPA. WPA uses TKIP (Temporal Key Integrity Protocol) to strengthen data encryption. Later, WPA2 and WPA3 were introduced as even more secure options. SSL is a protocol that secures online data transfer, not Wi-Fi networks. SAAS is a cloud service model and POP is an email protocol; both are unrelated to Wi-Fi security.

☛ Full form of WPA → Wi-Fi Protected Access

ऑप्टिकल कैरेक्टर रिकॉग्निशन (OCR) एक तकनीक है जो मुद्रित या हस्तलिखित टेक्स्ट को डिजिटल रूप में बदलती है। इस कार्य के लिए विशेष रूप से डिज़ाइन किया गया उपकरण ओसीआर स्कैनर होता है। यह स्कैनर टेक्स्ट को पढ़कर उसे संपादन योग्य इलेक्ट्रॉनिक डेटा में परिवर्तित करता है। अन्य विकल्प: ओएमआर स्कैनर चिह्नों (जैसे उत्तर पत्रिका) को पहचानता है, फ्लैटबेड स्कैनर सामान्य इमेज स्कैन करता है, और बारकोड रीडर केवल बारकोड पढ़ता है। इसलिए, केवल ओसीआर स्कैनर ही OCR का कार्य करता है।

question: Esc key in a windows keyboard is not used to (RRB NTPC Tier I (27/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: Close a dialog - box
Run a selected command
Cancel a command
Close a selected drop down list
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Run a selected command

Explanation:
The Escape (Esc) key in Windows is used to cancel an operation, close a dialog box, or close a drop-down list. It is never used to execute or run a selected command. In contrast, the Enter key is used to run a selected command or confirm an action. The Esc key primarily serves as a cancel or escape function, such as exiting full-screen mode (with F11) or dismissing a dialog. question: A serial port can (RRB NTPC Tier I (27/04/2016) Shift 2)
options: Only transfer information from a hard drive.
Only transfer information to a hard drive.
Transfer information both to and from a hard drive.
Neither transfer information from not to a hard drive.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Transfer information both to and from a hard drive

Explanation:
A serial port is an older computer interface that sends and receives data one bit at a time. It provides a bidirectional communication channel, meaning it can both read data from a hard drive and write data to a hard drive. Serial ports were commonly used to connect keyboards, mice, modems, and other peripherals. In modern computers, they have been largely replaced by USB and other high-speed ports.

☛ How is the data transfer rate of a serial port? → Slow
☛ What replaced the serial port in modern computers? → USB

question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (10/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Vint Cerf is recognised as one of the ‘Fathers of the Internet’.
In internet terminology, IP means Internet Practice.
The first computer in India was installed in the Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata.
Hotmail is the first free web-based email service introduced in 1995.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is In internet terminology, IP means Internet Practice.

Explanation:
This statement is incorrect because in internet terminology, IP stands for Internet Protocol, not Internet Practice. IP is a fundamental communication protocol that defines rules for sending and receiving data over the internet. Vint Cerf is indeed recognised as one of the 'Fathers of the Internet'. The first computer in India was installed at the Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata, which was a FACOM 128B. Hotmail was the first free web-based email service introduced in 1995. Therefore, the second statement is false.

question: The trial test of a computer or software before the commercial launch is called: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (10/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: e-test
Alpha test
Beta test
Delta test
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Beta test

Explanation:
The trial test of a computer or software before commercial launch is called Beta test. It is conducted by real users on the beta version of the software in a real environment to identify bugs and issues. In contrast, Alpha test is performed internally by the development team. Delta test is done after beta testing. Beta testing is a form of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) that helps improve product quality and user experience. It is a crucial step before the final release to ensure the software is stable and meets user expectations.

question: Which of the following is a First Generation Computer? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (11/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: ATLAS
STAR 1000
SEAC
ABACUS
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is SEAC

Explanation:
First generation computers used vacuum tubes. SEAC (Standards Eastern Automatic Computer) was built in 1950 and is a first generation computer. ATLAS is a second generation computer (transistor-based, 1962). STAR 1000 and ABACUS are not computers; ABACUS is an ancient calculating device. First generation (1940-1956) includes ENIAC, UNIVAC, IBM 701, etc. SEAC used vacuum tubes and was used for weather prediction and scientific calculations.

☛ Full form of ENIAC → Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer

question: Desktop computers, laptop computers, tablets and smartphones are different types of: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (13/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: microcomputers
mainframe computers
super computers
mini computers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is microcomputers

Explanation:
Desktop computers, laptops, tablets, and smartphones all fall under the category of microcomputers. Microcomputers are computers that use a microprocessor as their central processing unit and are designed for individual use. Mainframe computers are used by large organizations for bulk data processing. Supercomputers are extremely fast and used for scientific calculations. question: A/an ______ is required for booting a computer. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Operating system
Assembler
Compiler
Translator
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Operating system

Explanation:
An operating system is required for booting a computer. The booting process involves the computer performing a POST (Power-On Self-Test), followed by the BIOS/UEFI activating the boot loader, which loads the operating system into main memory. The operating system manages hardware and software resources, enabling the computer to function. Other options like assembler, compiler, and translator are used to convert programming languages into machine code, not for booting.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Required software for booting? → Operating system
☛ Full form of POST? → Power-On Self-Test
☛ What does the boot loader load? → Operating system
☛ Full form of BIOS? → Basic Input/Output System
☛ Function of assembler? → Converts assembly language to machine code

question: In Microsoft Word 2016, to remove paragraph formatting, one must press the shortcut keys ________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Ctrl + Q
Ctrl + Y
Ctrl + M
Ctrl + J
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ctrl + Q

Explanation:
In Microsoft Word 2016, to remove paragraph formatting, the shortcut Ctrl + Q is used. This command removes all manually applied formatting from the paragraph, such as indentation, spacing, and alignment. It is important to note that this shortcut affects only paragraph-level formatting, not character-level formatting (like bold or italic). Ctrl + Y is for redo, Ctrl + M increases indent, and Ctrl + J applies justify alignment.
